premises.text: There is a labor crisis in the US across multiple industries having a $1 trillion negative impact on the US economy
premises.evidence_span: there is a labor crisis in the US across the construction, agriculture, restaurant, and manufacturing industries having a $1 trillion negative impact on the US economy

premises.text: Robotic innovation has focused on factory automation that doesn't translate well to everyday automation
premises.evidence_span: Robotic innovation has focused on factory automation that doesn't translate well to everyday automation

premises.text: Current industrial robots are expensive and difficult to train
premises.evidence_span: these industrial robots have big external control boxes with difficult-to-manufacture strainwave gears and legacy PLCs, limiting where robots need to go in the future

premises.text: The Ally arm can significantly expand the market for robotic technology and everyday automation
premises.evidence_span: With a combination of machine vision, imitation learning, AI, and hardware innovation, we can significantly expand the market for robotic technology and everyday automation

premises.text: Proven planetary gears are more efficient and cost-effective than strainwave gears
premises.evidence_span: we've opted for proven planetary gears that are 97% efficient and 20% the cost of strainwave gears

premises.text: The Ally arm can be powered from standard AC outlets or 48 volt DC for mobile applications
premises.evidence_span: you can power the Ally arm from a standard 110 AC outlet or, for those in mobile applications, natively 48 volt DC

premises.text: The Ally arm's design allows for easy servicing and adaptability to various applications
premises.evidence_span: we've even invented a quick-change actuator. Now, anyone will be able to service the robot, just like replacing the batteries in your flashlight

premises.text: The Ally arm is designed to translate human gestures into robotic motion
premises.evidence_span: What you're seeing here is just the beginning of translating human gestures into robotic motion

premises.text: The Ally arm is the first robotic arm designed with AI and learning at its core
premises.evidence_span: The Ally arm is the first robotic arm designed from the ground up with AI and learning at the core

premises.text: Collaboration with NVIDIA will enhance development tools for the Ally arm
premises.evidence_span: We are collaborating with NVIDIA to adopt the Isaac platform for edge compute, AI, and simulation to accelerate our development

value.text: Robotics can be made accessible and easy to use for anyone, anywhere
value.evidence_span: together, we're enabling robotics for anyone, anywhere
